Identifying the location of CONAPESCA fishing locations.

step1_finding_locations.Rmd

Tried to match the Juan Carlos fishing data to the CONAPESCA landing site data using a variety of methods. There were still many places that were not matched. So, I used AI and Google searches to find the other locations to the best of my ability.

Here I will be joining Juan Carlos's data with the location of landing for Baja California and Baja California Sur.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(sf)
library(mapview)
library(osmdata)
library(stringi)


jc_data <- "/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/CONAPESCA/d2025/SharedByJuanCarlos/mex_landings/data/clean"

list.files(jc_data)

sites_BC <- read_csv(here("FP/FIS/v2025/data/landing_sites_BC.csv"))

fish <- readRDS(file.path(jc_data, "mex_landings_2000_present.rds")) 
fish_BC <- filter(fish, state %in% c("BAJA CALIFORNIA")) 

setdiff(fish_BC$landing_site, sites_BC$landing_site)

```
